caseName: New York & Porto Rico Steamship Co. v. Hermano
caseNameFull: New York and Porto Rico Steamship Company, in Error v. J. Ochoa y Hermano, etc. and New York and Porto Rico Steamship Company, in Error v. Successors of M. Lomba & Co., etc.

opinions.text: In error to the District Court of the United States for the *640District of Porto Rico. April 20, 1904. Dismissed with costs, on motion of Mr. James H. Hayden for plaintiff in error. Mr. John G. Carlisle, Mr. F. Kingsbury Curtis and Mr. Joseph K. McCammon for plaintiff in error. Mr. Frederic D. McKenney and Mr. F. H. Dexter for defendants in error.
